@graph.name: 3 Day Ijen, Bromo & Madakaripura Waterfall Discovery from Surabaya

review.reviewBody: I am glad I chose Java volcano tour operator. Your service is spectacular. Right from communication to providing on time service, it has been amazing over all. Now to specify the members of your team… Freddie was the first one to meet in Surabaya hotel, he is a very punctual sweet and friendly person who is always on time no matter what time of the day. Exceptional driving skills.\nNext we met Rendi for the ijen trek… again a very polite, punctual and well informed person. Kept us accompanied and encouraged us through out the trek. We had the time of our life these 2 days capturing memories for a lifetime. Every other person we encountered from your team for the jeep, cab and boat were all well coordinated and made us feel safe. Thank you once again for making it the best trip ever. I will highly recommend
